column1: # Commands the Claude Code hooks refuse outright, before they run.
# Unlike denied-paths, these are prevention, not review: there is no safe version
# of the action, so the answer is no rather than "a human should look".
# Every entry names the thing to do instead. A guard that only says "denied"
# trains people to disable it; a guard that says "use dx test" is followed.
